critical_findings.v17b_label_normalization_174k: Tested on 15k subsample (213->111 labels). Purity ratios 5x-10x but NMI decreases on normalized labels for 5/8 reps (increases for 3/8). Different regime from v17b 1K scale. Normalization merges labels embeddings were separating. Does NOT generalize in same-magnitude sense.
